subject: humanities
passage: Ballet dancers who perform on the tips of their toes wear pointe shoes, which have a stiff box at the front made of layers of fabric, paper, and glue. The box softens quickly with use, and a professional dancer may wear out a pair in a single ______ each pair can cost about $100, some large ballet companies buy thousands of pairs every year.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The first sentence ends after "performance." The words after the blank form a second sentence: the dependent clause "Although each pair can cost about $100" followed by the independent clause "some large ballet companies buy thousands of pairs every year." A period must come before "Although."
explanation.A: Incorrect. This choice attaches the "although" clause to the first sentence, leaving "some large ballet companies buy …" joined by only a comma: a comma splice.
explanation.B: Correct. A period ends the first sentence, and "Although …" begins the second, with a comma after the introductory clause.
explanation.C: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the two sentences run together.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A comma can't come right after the subordinating conjunction "although"; it separates the word from the clause it introduces.
